q.id: Tester menjalankan test dan melihat total keranjang salah. Developer lalu mencari baris kode penyebabnya dan memperbaikinya. Mana pernyataan yang benar?
q.en: A tester runs a test and sees a wrong cart total. A developer then finds the faulty code line and fixes it. Which statement is correct?

id: Tester melakukan testing (menunjukkan failure); developer melakukan debugging (menemukan dan memperbaiki penyebab)
Tester melakukan debugging; developer melakukan testing
Menemukan failure dan memperbaiki defect adalah aktivitas yang sama
en: The tester does testing (showing the failure); the developer does debugging (finding and fixing the cause)
The tester does debugging; the developer does testing
Finding a failure and fixing a defect are the same activity

exp.id: Testing memicu failure atau menemukan defect; debugging menganalisis dan memperbaiki penyebabnya. Konfirmasi perbaikan kembali menjadi testing.
exp.en: Testing triggers failures or finds defects; debugging analyses and fixes the cause. Verifying the fix is testing again.

q.id: Analis salah memahami aturan diskon (error), sehingga kode memakai rumus yang keliru (defect), dan pelanggan melihat harga salah (failure). Apa root cause paling awal dalam rantai ini?
q.en: An analyst misunderstood the discount rule (error), so the code used a wrong formula (defect), and a customer saw a wrong price (failure). What is the earliest root cause in this chain?

en: The analyst's misunderstanding of the discount rule
The wrong price the customer saw
The wrong formula in the code

exp.id: Root cause adalah penyebab awal yang jika dihilangkan mencegah defect: di sini kesalahpahaman (error). Defect ada di kode; failure yang terlihat pengguna.
exp.en: A root cause is the earliest cause which, if removed, prevents the defect: here the misunderstanding (error). The defect is in the code; the failure is what users see.

q.id: Sekitar 70% defect rilis lalu ditemukan di modul pembayaran, sementara modul lain hampir bersih. Prinsip testing mana yang paling menjelaskan ini, dan apa tindakannya?
q.en: About 70% of the last release's defects were found in the payment module while other modules were almost clean. Which testing principle best explains this, and what follows?

id: Defect clustering: fokuskan lebih banyak testing pada modul pembayaran
Absence-of-defects fallacy: berhenti menguji modul lain
Testing shows presence of defects: rilis ditunda selamanya
Exhaustive testing: uji semua kombinasi modul pembayaran
en: Defect clustering: focus more testing on the payment module
Absence-of-defects fallacy: stop testing other modules
Testing shows the presence of defects: delay the release forever
Exhaustive testing: test every combination in the payment module

exp.id: Defect clustering: sejumlah kecil modul memuat sebagian besar defect, jadi alokasi testing berbasis risiko perlu menyesuaikan. Tetap jangan menghentikan testing di modul lain (pesticide paradox dan konteks).
exp.en: Defect clustering: a small number of modules contains most defects, so risk-based allocation should adapt. Still don't stop testing elsewhere.

q.id: Requirement R-12 berubah. Manfaat traceability dua arah antara requirement, test case, dan hasil test dalam situasi ini adalah...
q.en: Requirement R-12 changes. The benefit of bidirectional traceability between requirements, test cases and results in this situation is...

id: Segera terlihat test case mana yang perlu ditinjau atau diubah (analisis dampak)
en: It is immediately visible which test cases must be reviewed or changed (impact analysis)
The requirement no longer needs testing

exp.id: Traceability mendukung analisis dampak perubahan, penilaian cakupan, dan pelaporan status terhadap requirement.
exp.en: Traceability supports change impact analysis, coverage assessment and status reporting against requirements.

q.id: Apa keuntungan utama dan risiko dari tingkat independensi testing yang tinggi (tester dari tim terpisah)?
q.en: What is the main benefit and risk of a high level of test independence (testers from a separate team)?

id: Keuntungan: sudut pandang berbeda dan bebas bias penulis; risiko: terisolasi dan developer merasa tidak lagi bertanggung jawab atas kualitas
Keuntungan: tidak butuh komunikasi; risiko: tidak ada
Keuntungan: defect pasti nol; risiko: biaya tool
Keuntungan: developer tidak perlu menguji; risiko: tidak ada
en: Benefit: different perspective and freedom from author bias; risk: isolation, and developers may stop feeling responsible for quality
Benefit: no communication needed; risk: none
Benefit: zero defects guaranteed; risk: tool cost
Benefit: developers need not test; risk: none

exp.id: Independensi membantu melihat asumsi yang terlewat, tetapi dapat memutus komunikasi dan membuat tim mengandalkan 'tester akan menemukan'.
exp.en: Independence helps expose missed assumptions but can break communication and breed 'the testers will catch it' thinking.

q.id: Siapa yang umumnya merencanakan, memantau, dan mengendalikan aktivitas test serta melaporkan status, dibanding yang merancang dan menjalankan test?
q.en: Who typically plans, monitors and controls test activities and reports status, as opposed to designing and executing tests?

exp.id: Dua peran: test management (perencanaan, pemantauan, kontrol) dan testing (analisis, desain, implementasi, eksekusi). Satu orang bisa memegang keduanya.
exp.en: Two roles: test management (planning, monitoring, control) and testing (analysis, design, implementation, execution). One person can hold both.

q.id: Pada TDD (test-driven development), urutan kerja yang benar adalah...
q.en: In TDD (test-driven development), the correct working order is...

id: Tulis test yang gagal, tulis kode agar lolos, lalu refactor
Tulis kode, lalu tulis test di akhir sprint
en: Write a failing test, write code to pass it, then refactor
Write code, then write tests at the end of the sprint

exp.id: Test-first approaches menulis test sebelum kode (red, green, refactor), sehingga test memandu desain.
exp.en: Test-first approaches write tests before code (red, green, refactor), so tests guide the design.

q.id: Mengapa pipeline CI/CD yang menjalankan regression otomatis pada setiap commit mendukung testing?
q.en: Why does a CI/CD pipeline that runs automated regression on every commit support testing?

id: Memberi umpan balik cepat atas perubahan sehingga defect ditemukan segera setelah diperkenalkan
Menjamin tidak ada defect di produksi
en: It gives fast feedback on changes so defects are found soon after introduction
It removes the need for test cases
It guarantees no defects in production

exp.id: DevOps menekankan umpan balik cepat dan otomasi. Pipeline mengurangi risiko tetapi tidak menjamin bebas defect dan tidak menggantikan eksploratori.
exp.en: DevOps stresses fast feedback and automation. A pipeline lowers risk but does not guarantee zero defects or replace exploratory testing.

q.id: Di retrospective sprint, tim menemukan banyak test otomasi flaky yang memperlambat rilis. Hasil retrospective yang paling sesuai tujuannya adalah...
q.en: In a sprint retrospective the team finds many flaky automated tests slowing releases. The outcome that best fits a retrospective's purpose is...

id: Menyepakati tindakan perbaikan proses, mis. stabilisasi test dan aturan karantina, lalu meninjau hasilnya sprint berikutnya
en: Agreeing improvement actions, e.g. stabilising tests and a quarantine rule, and reviewing the result next sprint
Blaming the tester who wrote the tests
Postponing the retrospective until after release

exp.id: Retrospective menghasilkan perbaikan proses dan test yang disepakati tim, tanpa menyalahkan individu.
exp.en: A retrospective yields team-agreed improvements to process and testing, without blaming individuals.

q.id: Tes yang memanggil API layanan pesanan dan layanan pembayaran bersama-sama untuk memastikan data dan kontrak antarlayanan benar termasuk level...
q.en: A test that calls the order service and payment service APIs together to check data and contracts between services is at the level of...

exp.id: Integration testing berfokus pada interaksi antar komponen atau sistem. Component testing menguji satu unit terisolasi; acceptance menilai kesiapan dari sisi bisnis; maintenance testing bukan level, melainkan pengujian saat sistem berubah.
exp.en: Integration testing focuses on interactions between components or systems. Component testing checks one isolated unit; acceptance judges business readiness; maintenance testing is not a level but testing during system change.

q.id: Mana yang termasuk functional testing, bukan non-functional?
q.en: Which is functional testing rather than non-functional?

id: Mengukur waktu respons dengan 1.000 pengguna bersamaan
Memeriksa data tetap aman saat serangan injeksi
en: Checking the tax calculation on an invoice
Measuring response time with 1,000 concurrent users
Checking how easy a new interface is to learn
Checking data stays safe under an injection attack

exp.id: Functional testing menilai apa yang dilakukan sistem. Performa, usability, dan keamanan adalah karakteristik non-fungsional.
exp.en: Functional testing evaluates what the system does. Performance, usability and security are non-functional characteristics.

q.id: Basis data produksi akan dimigrasikan ke platform baru tanpa perubahan fitur. Testing yang tepat?
q.en: The production database will be migrated to a new platform with no feature change. What testing fits?

id: Maintenance testing: uji migrasi data, lingkungan baru, dan regression untuk memastikan fungsi tetap benar
Tidak perlu testing karena fitur tidak berubah
en: Maintenance testing: test data migration, the new environment, and regression to confirm behaviour is unchanged
No testing needed since features did not change
Only component testing of one function
Only performance testing a year later

exp.id: Migrasi adalah pemicu maintenance testing, dengan analisis dampak untuk menentukan cakupan regression.
exp.en: Migration is a trigger for maintenance testing, with impact analysis to scope regression.

q.id: Jenis defect mana yang paling efektif ditemukan oleh static testing pada tahap requirement?
q.en: Which kind of defect is static testing at the requirement stage most effective at finding?

id: Requirement yang ambigu atau saling bertentangan
Lonjakan waktu respons pada jam sibuk

exp.id: Static testing memeriksa work product tanpa menjalankan kode. Masalah runtime seperti memori, performa, dan perangkat butuh dynamic testing.
exp.en: Static testing examines work products without running code. Runtime issues such as memory, performance and devices need dynamic testing.

q.id: Mana yang lebih mungkin ditemukan oleh static analysis tool daripada oleh dynamic testing biasa?
q.en: Which is more likely to be found by a static analysis tool than by ordinary dynamic testing?

id: Kode yang tidak pernah dijangkau (unreachable) dan pelanggaran standar penulisan kode
Waktu respons lambat pada beban tinggi
Salah hitung hanya pada input tertentu saat runtime
en: Broken layout in a specific browser
Miscalculation only for certain runtime inputs

exp.id: Static analysis menemukan masalah struktur kode tanpa menjalankannya. Perilaku runtime muncul lewat dynamic testing.
exp.en: Static analysis finds code-structure problems without executing it. Runtime behaviour surfaces through dynamic testing.

q.id: Urutan aktivitas review yang benar adalah...
q.en: The correct order of review activities is...

id: Planning, review initiation, individual review, issue communication and analysis, fixing and reporting
Individual review, planning, fixing, review initiation, communication
Planning, fixing and reporting, individual review, initiation, communication
Review initiation, planning, communication, individual review, fixing
en: Planning, review initiation, individual review, issue communication and analysis, fixing and reporting
Individual review, planning, fixing, review initiation, communication
Planning, fixing and reporting, individual review, initiation, communication
Review initiation, planning, communication, individual review, fixing

exp.id: Mulai dari perencanaan, memulai review, review individual, diskusi dan analisis temuan, lalu perbaikan dan pelaporan.
exp.en: Start with planning, initiate the review, individual review, discuss and analyse findings, then fix and report.

q.id: Review yang dipimpin penulis untuk menjelaskan work product kepada peserta dan mengumpulkan umpan balik, tanpa proses formal ketat, disebut...
q.en: A review led by the author to explain the work product to participants and gather feedback, without a strict formal process, is called a...

exp.id: Walkthrough dipimpin penulis. Inspection paling formal dengan peran, aturan masuk/keluar, dan metrik, serta dipimpin fasilitator terlatih.
exp.en: A walkthrough is author-led. An inspection is the most formal, with roles, entry/exit rules and metrics, led by a trained facilitator.

q.id: Dalam review formal, siapa yang mencatat isu dan keputusan yang muncul selama pertemuan?
q.en: In a formal review, who records the issues and decisions raised during the meeting?

id: Reviewer lain secara bergilir tanpa peran
en: Any reviewer in turn with no role

exp.id: Peran review: manager, author, facilitator/moderator, review leader, reviewer, dan scribe yang mencatat temuan.
exp.en: Review roles: manager, author, facilitator/moderator, review leader, reviewer and the scribe who records findings.

q.id: Pendaftaran menerima umur 18 sampai 64 (bilangan bulat, inklusif). Nilai uji BVA dua nilai yang tepat?
q.en: Registration accepts ages 18 to 64 (integers, inclusive). The correct two-value BVA test values?

exp.id: BVA dua nilai: tiap batas bersama tetangganya di partisi tidak valid: 18 dengan 17, 64 dengan 65.
exp.en: Two-value BVA: each boundary with its neighbour in the invalid partition: 18 with 17, 64 with 65.

q.id: Aturan ongkir: Jika Ekspres = Ya dan berat > 5 kg, biaya Rp50.000. Ekspres = Ya dan berat <= 5 kg, Rp30.000. Ekspres = Tidak dan berat > 5 kg, Rp20.000. Ekspres = Tidak dan berat <= 5 kg, Rp10.000. Paket 3 kg dikirim non-ekspres. Biayanya?
q.en: Shipping rules: Express = Yes and weight > 5 kg costs Rp50,000. Express = Yes and weight <= 5 kg, Rp30,000. Express = No and weight > 5 kg, Rp20,000. Express = No and weight <= 5 kg, Rp10,000. A 3 kg parcel is sent non-express. The cost?

exp.id: Kondisi: Ekspres = Tidak, berat > 5 = Tidak, cocok dengan rule keempat: Rp10.000.
exp.en: Conditions: Express = No, weight > 5 = No match rule four: Rp10,000.

q.id: Fungsi memiliki 10 statement yang dapat dieksekusi. Suite test mengeksekusi 8 di antaranya. Berapa statement coverage?
q.en: A function has 10 executable statements. The test suite executes 8 of them. What is the statement coverage?

exp.id: Statement coverage = statement yang dieksekusi / total = 8 / 10 = 80%.
exp.en: Statement coverage = executed statements / total = 8 / 10 = 80%.

q.id: Kode memiliki dua keputusan if/else yang berurutan dan independen (total 4 branch). Test yang ada menjalankan 3 branch. Berapa branch coverage?
q.en: The code has two independent consecutive if/else decisions (4 branches in total). Existing tests exercise 3 branches. What is the branch coverage?

exp.id: Branch coverage = branch yang dijalankan / total branch = 3 / 4 = 75%. 100% branch coverage selalu menjamin 100% statement coverage, tetapi tidak sebaliknya.
exp.en: Branch coverage = executed branches / total = 3 / 4 = 75%. 100% branch coverage guarantees 100% statement coverage, but not vice versa.

q.id: Tester menguji form dengan input kosong, spasi, emoji, dan string sangat panjang karena pengalaman bahwa input seperti itu sering memicu bug. Teknik apa ini?
q.en: A tester tries a form with empty input, spaces, emoji and a very long string because experience shows such inputs often trigger bugs. Which technique is this?

exp.id: Error guessing memakai pengetahuan dan pengalaman tester tentang di mana defect biasanya muncul, tanpa model formal.
exp.en: Error guessing uses the tester's knowledge and experience of where defects typically occur, with no formal model.

q.id: Acceptance criteria mana yang paling baik untuk story 'login'?
q.en: Which acceptance criterion is best for a 'login' story?

id: Setelah 5 kali password salah berturut-turut, akun dikunci 15 menit dan pengguna melihat pesan penguncian
Developer menulis kode login dengan rapi
en: After 5 consecutive wrong passwords the account is locked for 15 minutes and the user sees a lock message
Login must be secure and pleasant
The developer writes tidy login code

exp.id: Acceptance criteria baik spesifik, dapat diuji, dan tidak ambigu sehingga langsung menjadi test.
exp.en: Good acceptance criteria are specific, testable and unambiguous so they turn straight into tests.

q.id: Mana yang merupakan contoh exit criteria, bukan entry criteria?
q.en: Which is an example of exit criteria rather than entry criteria?

id: Semua test kritis lolos dan tidak ada defect kritis yang masih terbuka
Lingkungan test sudah siap dan dapat diakses
en: All critical tests pass and no critical defects remain open
The test environment is ready and accessible
The build has passed smoke testing

exp.id: Entry criteria menentukan kesiapan memulai; exit criteria menentukan kapan testing dianggap cukup selesai.
exp.en: Entry criteria define readiness to start; exit criteria define when testing is considered done enough.

q.id: Tiga sprint lalu, tim menyelesaikan pengujian 20, 24, dan 22 test case per sprint. Masih ada 66 test case yang harus diuji. Dengan ekstrapolasi dari rata-rata, perkiraan jumlah sprint?
q.en: In the last three sprints the team finished testing 20, 24 and 22 test cases per sprint. 66 test cases remain. Extrapolating from the average, about how many sprints are needed?

exp.id: Rata-rata (20+24+22)/3 = 22 per sprint. 66 / 22 = 3 sprint. Ekstrapolasi memakai data historis proyek yang sama.
exp.en: Average (20+24+22)/3 = 22 per sprint. 66 / 22 = 3 sprints. Extrapolation uses historical data from the same project.

q.id: Risiko = kemungkinan x dampak (skala 1-5). TC-A: 4 x 5, TC-B: 5 x 2, TC-C: 3 x 4, TC-D: 2 x 2. Urutan eksekusi berbasis risiko dari tertinggi?
q.en: Risk = likelihood x impact (scale 1-5). TC-A: 4 x 5, TC-B: 5 x 2, TC-C: 3 x 4, TC-D: 2 x 2. Risk-based execution order from highest?

q.id: Dalam testing quadrants, exploratory testing dan user acceptance testing yang mengkritik produk dari sisi bisnis berada di kuadran...
q.en: In the testing quadrants, exploratory testing and user acceptance testing that critique the product from the business side belong to the quadrant...

exp.id: Q1: component/integration; Q2: functional examples dan story tests; Q3: eksploratori, usability, UAT; Q4: performa, keamanan, dan karakteristik non-fungsional lain.
exp.en: Q1: component/integration; Q2: functional examples and story tests; Q3: exploratory, usability, UAT; Q4: performance, security and other non-functional characteristics.

q.id: Mana yang merupakan product risk (bukan project risk)?
q.en: Which is a product risk (not a project risk)?

id: Pembulatan salah pada perhitungan cicilan yang merugikan pelanggan
Anggota tim kunci pindah di tengah proyek
en: A rounding error in instalment calculation that harms customers
A key team member leaves mid-project

exp.id: Product risk menyangkut kualitas produk; project risk menyangkut manajemen dan kontrol proyek (orang, jadwal, anggaran, lingkungan).
exp.en: Product risks concern product quality; project risks concern project management and control (people, schedule, budget, environment).

q.id: Tingkat risiko ditentukan oleh kombinasi...
q.en: Risk level is determined by the combination of...

id: Jumlah baris kode dan jumlah test
en: Lines of code and number of tests

exp.id: Risiko dinilai dari seberapa mungkin kejadiannya dan seberapa besar akibatnya.
exp.en: Risk is assessed by how likely the event is and how severe its consequence would be.

q.id: Mana yang merupakan metrik progres testing?
q.en: Which is a test progress metric?

id: Persentase test case yang sudah dieksekusi dari yang direncanakan
en: Percentage of planned test cases executed

exp.id: Metrik umum: kemajuan eksekusi test, defect ditemukan dan diperbaiki, cakupan requirement atau kode, usaha dan biaya.
exp.en: Common metrics: test execution progress, defects found and fixed, requirement or code coverage, effort and cost.

q.id: Apa yang sebaiknya ada di test progress/summary report untuk manajer?
q.en: What should a test progress/summary report for managers contain?

id: Ringkasan testing, deviasi dari rencana, status terhadap exit criteria, metrik, dan risiko yang tersisa
Hanya jumlah test lolos tanpa konteks
en: A summary of testing, deviations from plan, status against exit criteria, metrics and remaining risks
Only the number of passed tests with no context

exp.id: Laporan disesuaikan dengan pembacanya: ringkas, bermakna, dan mendukung keputusan.
exp.en: Reports are tailored to the reader: concise, meaningful and decision-supporting.

q.id: Peran configuration management dalam testing adalah...
q.en: The role of configuration management in testing is...

id: Mengidentifikasi dan mengendalikan versi testware dan test item agar hasil test dapat ditelusuri ke versi yang diuji
en: Identifying and controlling versions of testware and test items so results trace back to the version tested

exp.id: Tanpa version control, hasil test tidak dapat direproduksi atau dikaitkan dengan build yang benar.
exp.en: Without version control, results cannot be reproduced or tied to the correct build.

q.id: Salah ketik nama merek di halaman checkout, sehari sebelum kampanye besar. Penentuan severity dan priority yang paling masuk akal?
q.en: A brand-name typo on the checkout page, one day before a major campaign. The most sensible severity and priority?

en: Critical severity because the system crashes

exp.id: Severity menyatakan dampak teknis pada fungsi; priority menyatakan urgensi perbaikan dari sisi bisnis. Typo tidak merusak fungsi tetapi mendesak diperbaiki sebelum kampanye.
exp.en: Severity states technical impact on function; priority states business urgency of the fix. A typo breaks no function but must be fixed before the campaign.

q.id: Tool yang melaporkan baris dan branch mana yang dijalankan oleh suite test termasuk kategori...
q.en: A tool that reports which lines and branches the test suite executed falls into the category of...

exp.id: Coverage tool mengukur seberapa besar kode terlaksana oleh test, dan dikelompokkan dengan tool eksekusi test.
exp.en: Coverage tools measure how much code the tests exercise and are grouped with test execution tools.

q.id: Mana yang merupakan risiko umum otomasi test?
q.en: Which is a common risk of test automation?

en: Less time is spent on repetitive tasks

exp.id: Tiga lainnya adalah manfaat. Risiko termasuk ekspektasi tidak realistis, perawatan diremehkan, dan ketergantungan berlebihan pada tool.
exp.en: The other three are benefits. Risks include unrealistic expectations, underestimated maintenance and over-reliance on the tool.

q.id: Tool CI/CD yang membangun dan menjalankan test setiap ada perubahan kode termasuk kategori dukungan...
q.en: A CI/CD tool that builds and runs tests on every code change belongs to the support category of...

exp.id: Tool DevOps mendukung build, integrasi, dan deployment otomatis sehingga test dijalankan konsisten.
exp.en: DevOps tools support automated build, integration and deployment so tests run consistently.
